title: Safe Deposit Boxes: when rent is charged, lease renewal and rent notices
content:
## Scope

This policy covers the timing side of rent on a Safe Deposit Boxes rental: when each year's rent is charged, whether the lease renews by itself, when the yearly rent notice is sent, and when a change in rent can take effect.

## Policy clause

1. Rent is charged once per rental year, in advance, on the rent due date. Each charge covers one rental year, which is one rental term, from its first day to its last day.
2. For the first rental year, the rent due date is the lease start date.
3. The lease renews automatically at the end of each term while automatic renewal applies to the box size; it applies to every size.
4. A rent notice is sent 30 calendar days before each rent due date.
5. A change in rent takes effect only at a renewal that falls at least 30 calendar days after the notice of the change.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Lease renews automatically | Rent notice sent before the due date | Notice needed before a rent change takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | Yes | 30 calendar days | At least 30 calendar days |

## Hypothetical timeline: the rent notice

For a rental whose rent due date is a hypothetical 31 July, the rent notice is sent 30 calendar days earlier, on 1 July, and the year's rent is charged in advance on 31 July.

## Rent change: boundary cases

The dates are hypothetical; the renewal falls on 1 June.

| Notice of the rent change given | Calendar days from the notice to the renewal | Can the change take effect at the 1 June renewal? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 31 | Yes |
| 2 May | 30 | Yes, exactly 30 days meets "at least 30" |
| 3 May | 29 | No |

## Basis Q&A

**Is rent billed monthly?** No. It is charged once per rental year, in advance, on the rent due date.

**Does the customer need to renew the lease each year?** No. The lease renews automatically at the end of each term for every box size.

**Can a rent change apply in the middle of a rental year?** No. A rent change takes effect only at a renewal, and only at one falling at least 30 calendar days after the notice.
